evidence.quoted_text: for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(overrides)) child[name] = value;
evidence.reason: The code applies overrides by exact object key at line 265. On Windows, environment names are case-insensitive, so an override such as `{ Path: replacement }` can coexist with an inherited `PATH`; Node sorts environment keys and passes the first case-insensitive match, allowing the inherited `PATH` to win. That contradicts `buildChildEnv`'s documented guarantee that overrides always win and is an ordinary implementation defect, not a new requirement. The smallest compatible fix is to merge overrides case-insensitively only on Windows while preserving case-sensitive behavior on POSIX.
